snippet.title: That Time I Found a Box - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481360/That_Time_I_Found_A_Box/
Demo available on Steam at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522940/That_Time_I_Found_A_Box_Demo/
Release on Steam - Est. September 2025

“That Time I Found A Box” is a roguelike deckbuilder where cards are blank slates for you to build, upgrade and modify as you like. Choose carefully when to play them and when / how to improve them.
Discover what’s possible with deep strategic card building and deck building resulting in vanishingly rare moments of there being only one obvious play available.
Choose your allies, have some fun and create game-breaking cards!... And most importantly, be able to put the box down and get out alive.
